scenes.title: Meetings After Partings
scenes.summary: Max reflects on how partings in life are always followed by new meetings, while Katya surprises her father Chef Barinov at Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: Sad Music in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: At Claude Monet, Kostya checks on Nastya while she comforts a heartbroken Vika with water and asks for livelier music.

scenes.title: Family Talk in the Office
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov shows Katya his new office at Arcobaleno, argues with her about disappearing for a year, and offends her when a vegetable delivery arrives.

scenes.title: Job Interview with German
scenes.summary: Katya brushes off her father's phone call while interviewing with German Land at Claude Monet, explaining why she left her father's kitchen.

scenes.title: Return to the Team
scenes.summary: German introduces Katya to the Claude Monet kitchen crew as their returning colleague, and she meets the new cook Denis.

scenes.title: Tyomochka's Birthday
scenes.summary: A demanding wealthy guest orders a special cappuccino from Nastya and tells Vika about celebrating her two-year-old Tyomochka's birthday.

scenes.title: A Banquet for a Dog
scenes.summary: The wealthy guest insists on closing the entire restaurant for her dog's birthday and accidentally makes Vika cry by mentioning her divorce.

scenes.title: Senya's Tip-Off
scenes.summary: Senya sneaks over to tell Chef Barinov that Katya is now working at Claude Monet under German's protection, sending Barinov into a rage.

scenes.title: Father and Daughter Argument
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov barges into the Claude Monet kitchen demanding that Katya come work for him, but she refuses to leave.

scenes.title: The New Sous-Chef
scenes.summary: German announces in front of Chef Barinov that Katya is appointed sous-chef of Claude Monet immediately and mocks Barinov.

scenes.title: Preparing for the Dog Party
scenes.summary: Vika congratulates Katya on becoming sous-chef while German offers Vika his sympathy and discusses the dog birthday banquet.

scenes.title: Meat Cake and a Bouquet of Flowers
scenes.summary: German assigns the dog banquet to Katya, who orders Senya and Denis to make a handsome meat cake while a courier brings flowers for Vika.

scenes.title: The Dog's Name-Day Party
scenes.summary: Vika angrily rejects the bouquet until she learns a courier brought it, and Senya tells Chef Barinov that Katya is running the dog banquet.

scenes.title: A Cat in a Bag
scenes.summary: Timur delivers a live cat in a collar to Chef Barinov, who bribes Senya with five thousand rubles to release the cat into Claude Monet.

scenes.title: A Cat at the Banquet
scenes.summary: The cat causes pandemonium at the dog birthday party, and when German calls the number on its collar, Katya's phone rings and she is fired.

scenes.title: Chef Barinov Exposed
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov comforts Katya at Arcobaleno after she is fired, until Senya bursts in bragging about the cat mission and exposes him.

scenes.title: Barinov's Confession
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confesses to Vika that he planted the cat so she will ask German to rehire Katya, while the dog owner refuses to pay.

scenes.title: Female Solidarity
scenes.summary: Seeing Vika cry over her unfaithful husband, the wealthy dog owner softens and shares how her own late husband cheated on her too.

scenes.title: The Bill for the Truffles
scenes.summary: Vika, Elena Pavlovna, and the dog owner unite against Chef Barinov and make him pay the huge bill for the ruined dog banquet.

scenes.title: Simple Particles of Happiness
scenes.summary: German rehires Katya for Vika's sake, Denis makes Vika smile, and Kostya and Nastya promise never to lie to each other again.
